why: Main picture is a calm, generic harbour scene ('fishing boats moored at a harbour in Chennai under a grey sky'), not Kasimedu as the hero asked for, and it shows neither the deaths and search at sea nor Chief Minister Vijay, who acted in the headline. A calm harbour is a stand-in under rules 1-3. The text also has two errors in both languages. (1) It says 'went missing at sea last week' / 'पिछले हफ्ते', but contact was lost on Tuesday, November 3, which is this week. (2) It says 'Five deaths were being reported by evening' / 'शाम तक पांच मौतों की खबर' with no source, which sits badly next to the three identified bodies everywhere else. (Text fixed in EN and HI: "on November 3", unsourced five-deaths sentence cut. Picture not fixable this run.)
